title: Add BuildGoal.Id property for outcome correlation
description: P1 from 10-agent audit. BuildGoal does not override Guid Id — inherits Guid.Empty from IGoal. All other 6 goals have per-instance Id = Guid.NewGuid(). All ActionOutcome.GoalId for build-derived outcomes are Guid.Empty, breaking per-goal outcome correlation for the entire build pipeline. Add public Guid Id { get; } = Guid.NewGuid(); to BuildGoal. Source: codebase-audit-20260711-10agent-swarm-5chair-council-post-wave-c.md (P1-003).
